metadata.what: Monthly 10 m wind climatology for the Gulf: Weibull fit, mean vector wind, and a 16 sector rose.
metadata.source: ERA5 hourly 10 m wind via the Open-Meteo historical archive, models=era5
metadata.licence: ERA5 under the Copernicus licence, Open-Meteo under CC BY 4.0. Attribution required.
metadata.fit: scipy weibull_min maximum likelihood with the location fixed at 0, on hourly speeds above 0.05 m/s
metadata.wind_convention: direction is the bearing the wind blows FROM; u is eastward, v is northward
metadata.rose: 16 sectors, [frequency, mean speed m/s, Fryberger Q in vector units accumulated hourly], stored only over the UAE working box and the Kuwait validation cell
